notes.title: Play & Chat with the Developers of Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion
notes.content:
Join us for this special Steam Next Fest Event featuring the developers from Stendhal Games as they dive into the captivating world of Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion - Prologue. Get a sneak peek at the game, witness exciting gameplay, and engage in real-time discussions with the creators.


 Exclusive Demo: Be among the first to experience the magic of Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion - Prologue with an exclusive demo.
 Live Gameplay: Watch the developers play the game, showcasing its unique features and mechanics.
 Q&A Session: Have burning questions? Interact directly with the developers during the live Q&A segment.
 Behind-the-Scenes Insights: Gain insights into the game’s development process, art style, and narrative.
 Community Interaction: Connect with fellow fans and share your excitement for this epic action role-playing adventure.

Mark your calendars and prepare to immerse your-self in the mystical world of Arcanima. Don’t miss this opportunity to be part of the journey before the official release!

[previewyoutube=GPRdKBkiJQI;full][/previewyoutube]

Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion combines Hack N Slash combat with JRPG elements, promising a deep and emotional story set in a world full of mysteries. Join us as we unravel the secrets of the Citadel of Indomita and explore the multicolored fog known as the ‘Mist of Oblivion’. See you there! 🌟🎮🔮
